resources.string: Shows a floating mic bubble when you are typing and inserts your dictated text into the focused text field. Vox reads only the focused text field and the name of the current app. Audio is sent to the speech server you set in Vox, and the text of what you said, with the name of the app you are in, is sent to the cleanup server you set (both Groq by default), each with your own API key. If you turn on relay sync, voice notes and your profile also go to your own relay.
